descriptions.sol35a_vector_service_dispatch_8008c858: Create and retain an original vector service, refresh position from the packet vector at +8, inline-copy the returned offset vector at +20 to service+120, copy the byte at packet+32 to service+116 and word at packet+36 to service+132, register with receiver+20, then release. Natural const-reference temporary lifetimes and a class offset setter reproduce the original PPC32 ABI and reload order; referenced data ownership remains external.
